1.title: Man Charged in Girl’s Abduction Nearly Four Years After She Was Last Seen
1.summary: The police found the girl, who was 15 when she disappeared in 2022 in Milwaukee, alive in Virginia in May. A man faces more than 60 charges, including abduction, in connection with the case.

2.title: How a Top Law Firm Went From Standing Up to Trump to Bending the Knee
2.summary: Paul Weiss was a progressive stalwart for decades and led the legal resistance against President Trump in his first term. Then it surrendered without a fight. This is the inside story of its transformation.

3.title: Chicago’s Mayoral Race Is Taking Shape. But What About the Incumbent?
3.summary: Several prominent Democrats already are running for mayor of Chicago. Mayor Brandon Johnson has not said whether he will seek a second term next year.

4.title: At least eight killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
4.summary: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.

5.title: Trump Says He Canceled Strikes on Iran, Claiming Progress on Outlines of a Deal
5.summary: President Trump has repeatedly threatened to escalate the war with Iran, only to abruptly back down. Saudi Arabia said its leader had urged Trump not to renew attacks.

6.title: Far-Right Leaders Step Up Calls for Expelling Remaining Migrants in Ceuta
6.summary: Spain’s leading far-right politician arrived in the territory on Sunday, fueling tensions there after thousands of migrants entered the exclave last week.
